title: Podcast: Clinical Matters - The European Association for Osseointegration EAO
html:
Clinical Matters is a new podcast from the European Association for Osseointegration (EAO). Each episode brings you closer to the science behind implant dentistry, translating cutting-edge research into practical insights you can apply in daily clinical practice.

Each month, hosts Nicole Winitsky and Lukas Fürhauser will bring you conversations with world-renowned clinicians who share the science, stories and strategies shaping our field.⁣⁣⁣ From research breakthroughs to practical insights you can apply in daily practice, this is your new go-to channel for professional growth and connection.⁣⁣⁣

Listen now

Episode 5: Failing to plan is planning to fail: Prosthetic complications in implant dentistry with Duygu Karasan

Successful implant treatment starts long before the restoration is delivered.

In this episode, hosts Nicole Winitsky and Lukas Fürhauser are joined by Duygu Karasan for a practical, evidence-based discussion on prosthetic treatment planning and the clinical decisions that influence long-term success.

From material selection and Ti-bases to occlusion, vertical dimension and cantilever restorations, the conversation explores how thoughtful planning can help clinicians prevent common prosthetic complications and achieve more predictable outcomes.

Listen now


Episode 4: How human factors affect your clinical outcome with Franck Renouard

Why do experienced clinicians still make mistakes?⁣

In this episode, Franck Renouard, former EAO President and internationally recognised expert in implant dentistry, explores the human factors behind clinical decision-making, sharing insights on how bias, pressure and perception can impact outcomes, and how to navigate them more effectively. 

Listen now


Episode 3: The Global Consensus for Clinical Guidelines with Frank Schwarz

The new GCCG guidelines are here, but what do they mean for your daily clinical decisions?⁣

In this episode, Frank Schwarz breaks down the rationale behind the guidelines and how they translate into real-world implant practice.⁣ 

Listen now


Episode 2: Immediate implants and loading with Gil Alcoforado

In this episode, EAO President Gil Alcoforado shares expert insights on immediate implant placement, evidence-based decision making, and the importance of prioritising long-term biological outcomes.

The conversation highlights how clinicians can balance scientific evidence with clinical experience to support safer, more predictable treatment decisions in daily practice.

Listen now


Episode 1: Beyond the limits with István Urban

In this very first episode of the Clinical Matters, we are honoured to introduce Dr. Istvan Urban. He is far more than a skilled surgeon—his mastery of intraoral bone and soft-tissue regeneration is truly extraordinary.

In this conversation, you’ll have the opportunity to learn about the strategies, principles, and thought processes behind his remarkable regenerative results.

Expect to deepen your understanding of soft- and hard-tissue management to further refine your skills, enabling you to deliver even better treatment outcomes for your patients.
